source.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an ORIGINAL production-style sprite design sheet for a reusable floating building-name tooltip in a tiny portrait pixel-art Chinese village game. This is a new design, not a copy of a reference. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard painted into the image. Warm cream parchment interior (#fff1cf), restrained ochre-gold highlight (#d4a15a), a thin warm dark-brown outline (#79502d), a subtle inner cream highlight. Crisp stepped pixel-art corners on a small rounded rectangular shape, flat colors, friendly and refined, no grain/noise, no gradients, no external drop shadow, no wood ornaments, no wheat, no icons, NO BUTTONS, NO TEXT. Exactly TWO isolated sprites, spaced widely on one landscape canvas: at the left, a complete closed rounded-rectangle tooltip body with approximate width:height ratio 2.4:1, perfectly straight horizontal/vertical edge runs and a solid uniformly colored blank center for nine-slice resizing; the body has NO POINTER attached. At the right, one separate small centered DOWNWARD pointing triangle, matching the body's cream fill and brown/gold edge pixels. The triangle's top edge is OPEN (no horizontal brown stroke), allowing it to overlap the body's bottom outline and join seamlessly. Triangle is about 1/7 the body's width and 1/3 its height. Draw as intentionally low-resolution pixel-art assets enlarged with nearest-neighbor hard pixels; body should be suitable to reduce to roughly 96 by 40 native pixels, tail roughly 14 by 10. Every asset entirely visible, generous transparent gutters, no labels, no guide lines, no buildings, no scene. The finished assembled tip will contain two large Chinese characters drawn by the game engine, so keep the interior entirely blank and readable.

preview.prompt: Create a clean design approval preview from the attached ORIGINAL pixel-art tooltip component sheet. Preserve this exact cream/ochre/warm-brown stepped pixel-art visual language and TRANSPARENT background. Assemble the body and small downward pointer seamlessly, with the tail centered on the bottom edge and no horizontal border cutting across its join. Show exactly TWO matching compact speech bubbles side by side, separated by ample transparent space. Each compact body's width:height should be about 2:1, with only a short centered downward pointer, no oversized tail. Left bubble exact Chinese text: "佟楼". Right bubble exact Chinese text: "南楼". Text is large, dark warm brown #6b4928, clear bold Chinese sans-serif, vertically and horizontally centered, ample equal padding. Do not put the text inside additional frames. The two speech bubbles should have identical dimensions. Keep colors flat and edges crisp. No buttons, close icons, labels, houses, characters, scenery, drop shadows, glows, or any other elements. This image is a design mockup, not a game screenshot. It must resemble a small polished tooltip that can appear immediately above a village house.
